title: Anti-Fraud Statement
meta_description: Hello dear customerNATURALIA GROUP will not ask you for relevant financial account and credit card information through text messages or phone calls in any name or reason.If you receive relevant phone calls or text messages, please be vigilant, and do not trust the instructions of unknown calls. If you have any doubts, please contact NATURALIA GROUP at the first time or call the Police Department for confirmation.When you receive an unknown call, please be vigilant, and beware of the method of the other party tampering with the phone number or pretending to be a specific company, bank, or judicial agency . Please do not click on unknown links, social media friend invitations or text messages you do not know.Common fraudulent tactics such as "repeated ordering" and "wrongly setting up installment payment" to win the trust of consumers, and then require online banking or ATM operation procedures. If it is related to bank accounts, please call the bank directly. If the content of the call requires you to operate relevant accounts and provide information, please refuse directly to reduce the risk of fraud.Please also change your password regularly, strengthen the password strength (use a mixture of uppercase and lowercase English and numbers), and do not enter account passwords on public computers to improve information security.NATURALIA GROUP customer service email：cs@naturalia-group.com

title: Return Policy
meta_description: I. Product Inspection PeriodWith the exception of products such as perishable goods, food items with a short shelf life (nearing expiration at the time of return/cancellation), customized products, current newspapers, periodicals or magazines, unsealed audio/video products or computer software, game point cards, other point cards, and opened personal hygiene products—which, according to the "Applicable Standards for Reasonable Exceptions to the Right of Rescission in Distance Sales," are not eligible for the 7-day inspection period—you will have a 7-day product inspection period (including holidays) starting from the day you receive the product.If you need to return a product, please contact our customer service within 7 days of receipt and provide the following information: "Name," "Order Number," "Contact Phone Number," "Product Name for Return," and "Reason for Return with Photos." Our customer service team will assist you with the return or exchange process upon receiving your request.Customer Service Email: marketing@naturalia-group.com  Customer Service Hotline: 2345 6488II. Return InstructionsReturned products must be unused and free from stains or damage not caused by human factors. The 7-day inspection period under the Consumer Protection Act is intended for your consideration and to confirm whether the product meets your needs; it is not a trial period. Unless otherwise indicated by our store, please keep the original packaging intact (including the outer shipping box). Returns will not be accepted otherwise.Returns cannot be accepted under the following circumstances:Exceeding the 7-day product inspection period.The product has been unsealed or used, or shows damage due to human factors, such as stains, malfunction, breakage, wear, scratches, scuffs, or soiling.The packaging of the returned product is damaged or incomplete, or the invoice or accessories are missing.Malicious or bulk returns.III. Return Process1.  Contact Customer Service: Submit a request via the customer service email or hotline.2.  Return Approval: A customer service representative will review your return request.3.  Prepare the Complete Product and Invoice: Repackage the product in its original packaging, including the invoice and all accessories.4.  Provide Pickup Information: Provide the customer service representative with a convenient pickup time, your contact information, and address for the return collection.5.  Logistics Pickup: We will arrange for our partnered logistics provider to collect the returned product.IV. Refund InstructionsCredit Card Payments: After the return is successfully confirmed, the refund will be credited directly to the original credit card account used for payment.Cash on Delivery Payments: After the return is successfully confirmed, the refund will be transferred to the bank account you provide.V. Exchange InstructionsProducts to be exchanged must be unused and free from stains or damage not caused by human factors. Unless otherwise indicated by our store, please keep the original packaging intact (including the outer shipping box). Exchanges will not be accepted otherwise.Exchange ProcessWhen you and Naturalia Group mutually agree to proceed with an exchange, please process a return for the original order and place a new order on our website for the desired product. We will only issue an invoice and collect or refund the price difference. If there is no price difference, no further action is required.

title: Privacy Policy
meta_description: NATURALIA GROUP Privacy PolicyUpdated and Effective Date: Aug 12, 2025{Company/Business Name/Individual Name} (hereinafter referred to as "we", "us" or "our"), the operator of NATURALIA GROUP, respects your concerns about privacy and values the relationship we have with you.When you visit the store (hereinafter referred to as the "Store") established by us under authorization from our SaaS service provider SHOPLINE (hereinafter referred to as "SHOPLINE"), we may collect, process, and utilize your personal data (including that of your employees and/or representatives handling affairs on your behalf). We may also collect, process, and utilize your personal data if you visit or make purchases on the Store. We are fully aware of the importance of personal data to you and are committed to ensuring the integrity and security of the Store. This Privacy Policy describes the types of personal data we collect about you, how we use this information, with whom we share it, and the choices available to you regarding our use of the information.This Privacy Policy will help you understand the following:What We CollectInformation You ProvideHow We Use Personal DataHow We Use "Cookies" and Other Similar Tracking TechnologiesHow We Process, Share, Transfer, and Disclose Personal DataYour Rights and ChoicesHow We Protect Personal DataHow This Privacy Policy Is UpdatedHow to Contact UsWhat We CollectWe may obtain personal data about you from various sources. We may collect this information when you provide it through our Store, [extensions], or through your visits and/or use of our social media/social networking pages (or their related stores or corresponding applications, such as Facebook, Instagram). Our products are sold in many department stores or other types of physical retail outlets. If you are a member of our Store, when you purchase goods in a physical store, [relevant records will also be collected by us.] When you visit this Store or our social media/social networking pages (or their related stores or corresponding applications), we may also collect certain information about your device or usage through automated means or using technologies like cookies, web server logs, and web beacons.Categories of Information You ProvideThe categories of personal data collected by the Store may include the following categories: 1. Identification Category - (1) Identifiers of Individuals (e.g., member's name, address, telephone number, email, etc.); (2) Financial Identifiers (e.g., credit card or financial institution account information, etc.); (3) Identifiers in Government Data (e.g., National ID number, Uniform Certificate number, Tax ID number, passport number, etc.). 2. Personal Characteristics Category - Personal Descriptions (e.g., gender, date of birth, size, etc.). 3. Social Circumstances – (1) Residence and Facilities (e.g., home address, etc.); (2) Property (e.g., owned movables or those with other rights, etc.); (3) Immigration Status (passport, work permit documents, residence permit documents, etc.); (4) Lifestyle (e.g., types of consumer goods used and details of services, etc.); (5) Membership in Charitable Organizations or Other Groups (e.g., records of participation in corporations, clubs, or other voluntary groups).Information You ProvideYou can choose to provide personal data to us in a number of ways, such as when you register on our Store, or when you shop on our Store, or through our social media (or their related stores or corresponding extensions). The types of personal data you may provide to us (where applicable) include:*   Contact information (e.g., name, postal address, email address, mobile or other telephone number, mobile service provider);*   Age and date of birth;*   Gender, preferred language;*   Race, gender, preferred language;*   Username and password;*   Payment information (e.g., your payment card number, expiration date, shipping address, and billing address);*   Purchase history;*   Product preferences and communication channel preferences;*   Content you provide (e.g., photos, videos, reviews, articles, survey responses, and comments);*   Information provided to us when you visit our social media pages (e.g., your name, profile picture, likes, location, friend list, and other information described on the social media network or application registration page, or details of your geographical location when using our mobile application);*   Device identifiers, such as information about the device, like MAC address, IP address, or other online identifiers.Providing your personal data to us is voluntary. However, if you do not provide your personal data, you may not be able to obtain certain services and promotions.Why We Collect Your Personal DataThe specific purposes for which the Store collects personal data are all for providing you with goods or services, including but not limited to providing: (1) Consumer and customer management and service; (2) Consumer protection; (3) Online shopping and other e-commerce services; (4) Verifying your personal identity (e.g., to protect you from criminal acts such as fraud); (5) Resolving various types of disputes (including but not limited to consumer disputes, intellectual property disputes, etc.); (6) Enhancing security in transactions; (7) Debt collection; (8) Notifying you of business opportunities, products, services, and updates; (9) Detecting and protecting you and the Store from errors, fraud, or other criminal activities, and monitoring compliance risks; (10) Investigating potential illegal conduct against personal safety, property safety, and breaches of contract; (11) Fulfilling the Terms and Conditions and Return/Exchange Policy; (12) Actions as required by laws and regulations; and (13) Other purposes for which consent was obtained at the time of collection.How We Use Personal DataWe may use the information you provide for the following purposes:*   Sending promotional content or other communications to you;*   Providing you with the information and services you requested;*   Contacting you to follow up or confirm your order, appointment, returns, or refunds, and sending you other non-marketing communications related to the products and services we provide to you;*   Processing your payments and/or transactions;*   Creating and managing your account, including access to your purchase history;*   Responding to your inquiries;*   Customizing advertisements on our Store, social media stores, and elsewhere to match your interests and history;*   Communicating with you and managing your participation in special events, contests, sweepstakes, events (if any), surveys, and other offers;*   Operating and communicating with you regarding our social networks or [mobile applications];*   Operating, evaluating, and improving our business (including developing new products and services; enhancing and improving our products and services; managing our communications; analyzing our products; performing market research, data analysis, and customer relationship management programs; and performing accounting, auditing, and other internal functions);*   Complying with applicable legal requirements, relevant industry standards, and our policies;*   Performing data cleansing, linking, or merging our records internally or through our service providers periodically to avoid duplication and ensure the accuracy of your information.We may also use the information in other ways for which we provide specific notice at the time of collection.If you provide your personal data to us, we intend to use it for direct marketing purposes to provide or promote the availability of our goods and/or services. However, we will confirm upon the first marketing message sent to you that you have not opted out of such marketing messages; if you are unwilling, you can express your wish to us when you first receive the marketing message, or you can refuse to receive further marketing messages at any time.If you provide us with the relevant data and explicitly consent to such use, we may use the various types of personal data listed in the "Information You Provide" section above for direct marketing.Direct marketing communications may be sent to you through various channels, including telephone, mail, email, SMS, mobile applications, web applications, social media stores, and other communication methods. [Note: Include all applicable to your business] If your consent has been obtained, the personal data you provided in the form, or the personal data you provided when consenting to the aforementioned subscription, will be used by us for that marketing purpose simultaneously. Our handling of any data transfer issues mentioned in this paragraph will be consistent with the provisions provided in this Privacy Policy.If you do not wish us to use your personal data for direct marketing, you may opt out of our direct marketing at any time by following the procedures outlined in the "Your Rights and Choices" section below. If you require it, we must cease using your personal data for direct marketing purposes without charging you any fee.We will only use the personal data you provide for direct marketing in accordance with the Personal Data Protection Act of the Republic of China. Our direct marketing content may take several forms, including but not limited to marketing mail, email, and SMS, the details of which are listed in the subsections below.How We Use "Cookies" and Other Similar Tracking Technologies(1) What are "Cookies"Cookies are small files stored on your computer, mobile phone, or any other smart terminal device by the Store's server when you log in to the Store or browse the Store's content. They usually contain an identifier, the Store's name, and some numbers and characters. When you visit the Store again, the Store can recognize your browser through the Cookie. Cookies may store user preferences and other information.(2) How We Use "Cookies"When you use our Store, we may collect information such as the device model, operating system, device identifier, and login IP address of the data subject through Cookies or similar technologies, and cache the data subject's browsing information and click information to understand the data subject's network environment. Cookies allow us to recognize your identity when visiting the Store, continuously optimize the user-friendliness of the Store, and adjust the Store according to your needs. You can also change your browser settings so that the browser does not accept Cookies from our Store, but this may affect your use of certain functions of the Store.On the Store we have established via SHOPLINE, with the help of Cookies and other similar technologies, we can identify whether you are an existing user or member without requiring re-login and authentication on each page.(3) How to Manage "Cookies"You can manage or delete certain categories of tracking technologies based on your preferences. Many browsers have a "Do Not Track" feature that can send a "Do Not Track" request to the Store.In addition to the controls we provide, you can also choose to enable or disable cookies in your internet browser. Most internet browsers also allow you to choose whether to disable all cookies or only third-party cookies. By default, most internet browsers accept cookies, but this setting can be changed. For more details, please see the "Help" menu in your internet browser or your device's documentation.The following links provide instructions on how to control cookies in all major browsers:*   Google Chrome: https://support.google.com/chrome/answer/95647?hl=en*   Internet Explorer: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/help/260971/description-of-cookies*   Safari (Desktop): https://support.apple.com/kb/PH5042?locale=en_US*   Mozilla Firefox: https://support.mozilla.org/en-US/kb/cookies-information-websites-store-on-your-computer?redirectlocale=en-US&amp;redirectslug=Cookies*   Opera: https://www.opera.com/helpIf you use any other browser, please refer to the documentation provided by the browser.On the Store, you can delete existing tracking technologies by clearing the cache.When you browse the web without logging in, we collect the Cookies necessary to enable browsing functions to provide you with relevant services.Please note that if you refuse to use or delete existing tracking technologies, you will need to manually change user settings each time you visit, we may not be able to provide you with a quality user experience, and some functions may not work properly.How We Process, Utilize, Share, Transfer, and Disclose Personal Data(1) Processing and UtilizationCertain functions of the Store may be provided by our third-party partners, and we may entrust partners (including technical service providers) to process certain personal data of yours. For example, when you use the automatic payment function, we may ask a third-party payment company to process your credit card information to collect relevant service fees from you as instructed; when using SHOPLINE Payments, we may ask third-party service providers to process personal data of you and your customers, these providers can facilitate "Know Your Customer" as well as transaction monitoring and risk management. [Note: Add any other vendors you share this information with. E.g., sales channels, payment gateways, shipping and fulfillment apps] We will sign confidentiality agreements with third-party service providers to manage the purpose of data processing, processing period, and responsibilities of both parties, and will require partners to process data according to our requirements and this Privacy Policy. If you do not agree with the partner collecting the personal data necessary to provide the relevant services, you or your customers may not be able to use the relevant services.(2) SharingWe will not share personal data with any third party, except in one or more of the following circumstances:*   According to your request, or with your prior explicit authorization or consent;*   Related to fulfilling our obligations under laws and regulations;*   Directly related to national security or national defense security;*   Directly related to public safety, public health, or significant public interests;*   Directly related to criminal investigation, prosecution, trial, and execution of judgments;*   Necessary to protect the vital legal interests of life, property, etc., of you or any other person, where obtaining the person's consent is difficult;*   The personal data involved has been disclosed to the public by you;*   The personal data involved is collected from legally and publicly disclosed information.*   Sharing with SHOPLINE and SHOPLINE Affiliates: In order to provide you with SHOPLINE products and services, make recommendations that may interest you, resolve account issues, and protect the personal and property safety of our affiliates, other users, or the public, you acknowledge and agree that we may share your and your customers' personal data with our affiliates. We will only share personal data to the extent necessary and subject to the purposes set out in this Privacy Policy. If we share sensitive personal data or if our affiliates use and process personal data for different purposes, we will seek your authorization and consent again.*   Sharing with our third-party partners: We will only share personal data for lawful, legitimate, necessary, specific, and explicit purposes, and will only share the personal data necessary to provide you or your customers with relevant services. We will not share personal data that can identify you unless otherwise stipulated by laws or regulations. Typically, these third-party partners are also data controllers, and they will process personal data in their own accounts after obtaining your consent. Such partners may have their own separate privacy policies and user agreements.[If you use third-party marketing apps that collect information about buyer activity on your store, insert] Additionally, when we use the Store, we may use third-party functions or services (including applications from Apps Stores, payment gateways, or logistics service providers). Please note that such functions or services are provided by third parties. The rules and procedures described in this Privacy Policy do not apply to such third-party functions and services. Any information you provide to third-party stores or services will be provided directly to the network operators of those services. Even if accessed through the Store, you must comply with the applicable privacy policies and user agreements (if any) of these third parties. We are not responsible for the content of any third-party store or the policies of third parties regarding personal data and security measures. Before providing any personal data to a third party, you should read and understand the third party's privacy policies and user agreements.(3) TransferIn principle, we will not transfer control of personal data to any third party, except in the following circumstances:*   At the request of the data subject, or with your prior explicit authorization or consent;*   Related to fulfilling our obligations under laws and regulations;*   Directly related to national security or national defense security;*   Directly related to public safety, public health, or significant public interests;*   Directly related to criminal investigation, prosecution, trial, and execution of judgments;*   Necessary to protect the vital legal interests of life, property, etc., of you or any other person, where obtaining the person's authorization and consent is difficult;*   The personal data involved has been disclosed to the public by you;*   The personal data involved is collected from legally and publicly disclosed information;*   Transfer due to changes in the operating entity in the event of acquisition, merger, reorganization, or bankruptcy.Note: If a transfer is required for the reasons above, we will inform you of the purpose and type of information and the recipient (we will also notify you if sensitive information is involved) before the transfer and obtain your consent, unless otherwise stipulated by laws or regulations. The recipient shall continue to fulfill the personal data-related obligations under this agreement. If we go bankrupt or cease operations and there is no recipient, we will delete or anonymize your personal data.(4) Public DisclosureIn principle, we will not disclose your personal data to the public or an undefined group of people, but we may disclose your personal data in accordance with our agreement with you or applicable laws and regulations.MinorsThis Store is not intended for individuals under the age of 18. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children. If you are a parent or guardian and believe that your child has provided personal data to us, please contact us at the address above to request deletion.Your Rights and ChoicesRegarding the personal data we collect from you, we provide you with certain choices, such as how we use the information and how we communicate with you. To update your preferences, ask us to remove your information from our mailing lists, or submit a request, please contact us as instructed below.Email Opt-OutYou can tell us not to send you marketing emails by clicking the unsubscribe link in any marketing email you receive from us or by contacting us as described in the "How to Contact Us" section below. You may also opt out of receiving our marketing emails by sending an opt-out request to cs@naturalia-group.com. SMS Opt-OutYou can ask us not to send you text messages by contacting us as follows: [Provide contact method, e.g., reply STOP, or email address].Social Networking Application Opt-OutTo remove or delete our social media application from your social networking account, please follow the instructions within the social network.For Facebook: Please see the instructions provided in the Facebook Help Center.Geolocation InformationWhen you use our mobile application, you may be asked to share your geographic location through the mobile application. You can choose not to share your geolocation details by adjusting the location services settings on your mobile device. To refuse to share your geolocation details, follow the instructions on your mobile device to change the relevant settings; otherwise, please contact your service provider or device manufacturer.Withdrawing ConsentYou may withdraw any consent you previously provided to us or object at any time on legitimate grounds to the processing of your personal data. We will apply your preferences going forward. In some cases, withdrawing your consent to our use or disclosure of your personal data will mean that you cannot take advantage of certain of our products or services.Viewing, Updating, and Modifying Personal DataWe may retain and use your information as necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined above. You have the right to request access to and receive details about the personal data we maintain about you, to update and correct inaccuracies in your personal data, and to have the information blocked or deleted, as appropriate. In some cases, the right to access personal data may be limited by the requirements of applicable law. We may take reasonable steps to verify your identity before granting access or making corrections. You can request to view, change, or delete your personal data by sending an email to cs@naturalia-group.com How We Protect Personal DataWe maintain appropriate administrative, technical, and physical safeguards designed to protect the personal data you provide against accidental, unlawful, or unauthorized destruction, loss, alteration, access, disclosure, or use. However, no system is perfectly secure or free from concerns, and we cannot guarantee that information about you will remain secure under all circumstances, including the security of your data during transmission to us or the security of data on your mobile device.For information on how SHOPLINE retains and protects personal data, please see the SHOPLINE Privacy Policy (https://shopline.tw/about/privacy).How We Update This Privacy PolicyThis Privacy Policy may be updated periodically without prior notice to reflect changes in our personal data practices. We will post a prominent notice on our Store to notify you of any significant changes to our Privacy Policy and will indicate the date of the most recent update at the top of the policy.How to Contact UsIf you have any questions or comments about this Privacy Policy, or if you would like us to update information we have about you or your preferences, please contact us by email at cs@naturalia-group.com.

可能會存儲使用者偏好和其他資訊。（2） meta_description: 韻濤健康肌膚管理中心是韻濤集團控股有限公司旗下的特許經營連鎖品牌，秉承以人為本、專業為根的原則，以科技、專業、醫學的理念打造一個全方位的健康肌膚管理系統。

title: 加入我們
meta_description: 加入我們現誠聘銷售營業代表及美容培訓導師，同時，如你現經營美容院，或者從未接觸美容行業，都可參加我們的投資或轉型計劃，獲取持續的豐厚投資回報。只要你有發展事業的野心，歡迎立刻與我們聯絡。

title: 理念 ‧ 宗旨
meta_description: 理念 ‧ 宗旨成就新出路!將科技、專業、醫學、健康及思維融合, 帶領客人站在市場尖端!韻濤集團致力成為國際級醫學美容集團，我們亦視團隊和產品為企業的生命力!團隊我們深信培養員工專業知識的重要，著重團隊發展，秉承「以人為本，專業為根」的精神，鼓勵不同範疇的員工自我進修及互相學習，持續提升競爭力和應變能力。以「開心做事，快樂做人」的理念，為員工創造恣意發揮的平台，鼓勵員工發揮最大潛能，為公司和員工帶來雙贏。

title: 社會責任
meta_description: 韻濤認為企業社會責任 (Corporate Social Responsibility, CSR) 不單單只是參與公益事務，更應從心底裡願意為社會、為環境無私地付出。逾二十年基業，我們以４大範疇為核心，多方面為員工，社區，商界及生態環境貢獻。

title: 貝嘉文
meta_description: 貝嘉文Naturalia Sintesi 始創於1976年。原身是意大利製藥公司（Bergamon SPA），並是生物科研美容產品的先驅，在皮膚科運用生物技術進行研發。在安全性和效果上，Naturalia Sintesi盡量減低防腐劑和香料在成份中的比例。在生產和測試階段中，產品對所有級別的皮膚所達到的效果和耐受性，均達至歐洲標準。

title: 集團概況
meta_description: 傳播專業、科學、嚴謹的正確護膚觀念、輸出健康美的生活方式韻濤集團控股有限公司，是一間富有實力及信譽的亞太區知名健康管理集團，以優質產品、服務和團隊管理領先同業，為業界樹立最高標準。現時本集團在香港、澳門、大中華地區及東南亞地區均設有分公司及附屬公司。

title: 集團里程碑
meta_description: 集團里程碑以創新理念迎接明天無限挑戰憑藉創新及具遠見的企業精神，成就今天的高速擴張發展我們期待在不久的將來，能與閣下攜手合作，在往後的日子能出色的表現以及雙贏的局面來豐富我們的發展里程。

title: 露明華國際美容學院
meta_description: 露明華國際美容學院不斷增值·成就未來露明華國際美容學院於2009年創辦，希望提供專業正確的營養知識予各階層人士，藉此推廣及提昇社會人士對健康及營養的關注。學院為學員提供一套實用而受認可的營養課程，完成課程後學員更可考獲英國CIBTAC營養學文憑之資格。

title: 露明華
meta_description: “綻放美麗‧綠色種子” 開創獨特的全球新趨勢，追求最完美的天然產品優質種子、優質培育、嚴謹研發過程是法國露明華成功秘訣，法國露明華成立於1978年，專門研究植物天然寶庫，亦是全球首個關注研發完美種子美容。揉合美麗與健康的概念，一直致力提倡美容揉合零污染、純天然、健康及環保享譽盛名。

title: 面部肌膚健康管理 Facial Skin Health Management
meta_description: 面部肌膚健康管理健康肌膚管理中心率先引入Young Again® 聚焦太陽有益光，透過獨家的LEDs二極管同時輸出達136條、0.5CM近距離聚焦輸送太陽有益光，糅合3種波長不一的太陽有益光——紅光(624nm)、藍光(417nm)、黃光(590nm)和紅外光 (834nm)，自然活化細胞機能。

title: 韻濤健康肌膚管理中心
meta_description: 韻濤健康肌膚管理中心健康肌膚管理中心 是一間以高科技儀器設備和生物科技產品為載體，專注解決各種問題性皮膚的治療中心。憑藉全球唯一的專利科技，為客戶提供專業皮膚檢測和量身定制皮膚管理方案，全方位管理並解決客戶的皮膚問題，實現由內而外的健康，從外至內的美麗！

structured_data.name: Delight 3 Pro專業套裝
structured_data.description: 功效：抗色素異常 , 美白提亮 , 抗衰老療程,  改善膚色暗沉及蠟黃, 保濕 ,祛斑 使用方法：（美容院療程）清潔+爽膚 :使用超溫和清潔霜清潔並徹底沖洗。煥膚階段(去除死細胞):對於敏感肌膚,技師可根據情況每次避免去角質或縮短使用時間,輕拍幾滴修顏精華液。用扇形刷薄薄塗抹3-5ml的Delight 3PRO第一步煥膚產品,停留5分鐘。必要時,在沖洗前用指尖輕輕按摩重點區域。清潔/沖洗 :徹底沖洗。平衡參數(pH值+天然保濕因子)輕拍塗抹一層薄的特殊消失霜恢復pH值,然後用紗布輕拍特殊保濕復合物恢復天然保濕因子。註:前4次護理必須執行此步驟,之後可由操作師酌情選擇。 僅在色斑處塗抹0.5ml Delight擊退黑斑精華,直到吸收。控制黑色素形成階段 : 用輕刷動作在全臉塗抹5ml Delight 3PRO第二步啫哩激活劑,停留5分鐘。昇華階段 : 用刷子塗抹10ml Delight 3PRO第三步驟護理面膜,停留7-10分鐘,期間可進行指壓按摩。時間到後,透過抗老按摩讓剩餘面膜吸收。 最後用微濕棉片輕拍去除殘留物。結束護理:最後塗抹一層多效防護霜抵禦外界環境。護理週期 :建議至少先進行4-5次護理(為一個療程),每週1次。其後每15天進行1次護理(4次為一個療程) 。最後每月進行1次維護護理。注意:針對色斑問題,必須使用完整的美容護理流程。
